name: Active & Passive Piezo Buzzer
description: Like a monster voice! Vibrates a piezo ceramic disc to emit beeps, songs, and alarm sounds.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a monster voice! Vibrates a piezo ceramic disc to emit beeps, songs, and alarm sounds.
wiringGuidance: Connect positive (+) terminal (Red/Green wire) to digital pin 8 and negative (-) terminal (Dark Slate wire) to GND.
commonMistakes: Confusing active buzzers (constant tone on DC) with passive buzzers (require tone() PWM frequency).
Reversing polarity on active buzzer modules.

miniExperiment.title: Chirp & Melody Player
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Buzzer plays two cheerful alternating tones every second.
